model_annotations.Bulgarian: The plot titled “Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-2” illustrates how sparsity ratio varies across network layers for three conditions. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and uses a linear scale, spanning approximately 0 to 23 with major tick labels shown at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20. The y-axis is labeled “Sparsity Ratio” on a linear scale from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1.0. A blue dashed line (no markers) labeled “sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03” starts near 0.18 at layer 0, drops to around 0.04 by about layer 2, and then stays close to 0.02–0.04 through most layers, ending near 0.01 by the final layer. An orange dotted line (no markers) labeled “sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44” begins near 1.0 at layer 0, declines steadily to roughly 0.30 by around layer 10 and to about 0.18–0.22 around layers 13–16, then fluctuates upward and downward in later layers, reaching about 0.40 near layer 21 and ending around 0.38 at the last layer. A green dash-dot line (no markers) labeled “sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33” starts near 1.0 at layer 0, decreases to about 0.35 by around layer 8 and to roughly 0.18 by around layer 11, then continues downward more gradually to around 0.10 by about layers 15–18, with small fluctuations near 0.08–0.12 before ending near 0.05 at the final layer.

model_annotations.English: The plot titled “Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-2” illustrates how sparsity ratio varies across network layers for three conditions: before a gate, after a gate, and after an average gate. The x-axis is labeled “Layer,” uses a linear scale, and spans integer layers from 0 to 23 with major tick labels shown at 0, 5, 10, 15, and 20. The y-axis is labeled “Sparsity Ratio,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick labels at regular 0.2 intervals. The blue dashed line (no markers) labeled “sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03” starts near 0.18 at layer 0, drops to about 0.04 by layer 2, then stays close to 0.02–0.04 through most layers, ending near 0.01 at layer 23. The orange dotted line (no markers) labeled “sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44” begins near 1.0 at layer 0, declines steadily to around 0.47 by layer 8 and about 0.30 by layer 10, reaches roughly 0.18–0.22 around layers 13–16, then fluctuates upward and downward in later layers, including values around 0.28 at layer 19, about 0.20 at layer 20, a local high near 0.40 at layer 21, about 0.25 at layer 22, and ending near 0.38 at layer 23. The green dash-dot line (no markers) labeled “sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33” starts near 1.0 at layer 0, decreases to about 0.60 by layer 5 and about 0.35 by layer 7, continues downward to roughly 0.18 at layer 10 and about 0.10–0.13 around layers 14–16, stays near 0.09–0.11 through about layer 21 with small fluctuations, and then declines to approximately 0.05 by layer 23.
